observable_failure_step.description: Table element 135 note and Table 22 header generated without checking for mandatory 'یادداشت:' prefix and untranslated English text 'Bentler'.

root_cause_diagnosis: The defect occurred because the deserialized table note from 05_macro_model.json ('N = ۴۸۳. برآورد با روش حداکثر...') was passed directly to add_table_note without defensive prefix enforcement. Furthermore, the raw header containing the English word 'Bentler' was injected directly into OpenXML and Markdown without transliterating to formal academic Persian ('هو و بنتلر، ۱۹۹۹').
prescribed_behavior: Enforce defensive validation prior to document compilation: automatically prepend the 'یادداشت: ' prefix to table notes if missing. Perform strict transliteration of English author names (e.g., 'Bentler' to 'هو و بنتلر، ۱۹۹۹') before injecting text strings into Markdown or OpenXML deliverables, enforcing zero inline Latin script within Persian tables/narratives.
